nodes.name: Claim due follow-ups
nodes.notes: Locks due rows (status processing) so two runs never take the same follow-up.

nodes.name: Gmail API: read thread
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: needs labelIds + internalDate for every message in the thread. Re-checks Gmail right before sending.

nodes.name: Decide
nodes.notes: Cancels on: customer replied, booking confirmed/declined/closed, paused, staff wrote since. Hold = auto follow-up switch off.

nodes.name: Load saved text

parameters.query: select id, step, nullif(trim(coalesce(subject, '')), '') as subject, nullif(trim(coalesce(message_body, '')), '') as message_body from followups where id = $1::uuid;

nodes.notes: Reads text staff (or an earlier AI run) already saved.

nodes.name: Fail follow-up
nodes.notes: Any failure after the claim ends here: status failed + readable last_error. Never stuck in processing.

nodes.name: Claim draft requests

parameters.query:
select f.id as followup_id, f.step, nullif(trim(coalesce(f.message_body, '')), '') as message_body, jw_followup_context(f.enquiry_id) as context
from followups f
where f.ai_draft_requested_at is not null and f.status in ('scheduled','due')
order by f.ai_draft_requested_at limit 10;

nodes.notes: 'Write it now': staff asked for AI text. Write and save it, never send.

nodes.name: Fail draft

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Claim draft requests').item.json.followup_id, 'AI draft failed: ' + String($json.error?.message ?? $json.error ?? $json.message ?? 'unknown error') ] }}

parameters.query: update followups set ai_draft_requested_at = null, last_error = left($2, 500) where id = $1::uuid;

nodes.notes: Draft failed: clears the request and shows the reason in last_error. The follow-up itself stays scheduled.
